back_notes.chrome.nav.plat-appliance: "Пристрій" (device) as a platform name is vague; "appliance" sense not obvious.
back_notes.chrome.docs.short: "Докум." is an abbreviation of "Документація" and looks odd as a nav label.
back_notes.home.install.span-1: "основний випуск" lit. "main release" for what is presumably "stable".
back_notes.home.p-linux.a-1: "Посібник" (manual/guide) as the label for installation is ambiguous.
back_notes.home.p-appliance.li-4: 'об’єкта без виходу в інтернет' unusual wording for a site without outside network access. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.home.why-cache.figcaption-3: "щаблі" (rungs) for load-test steps is unusual wording.
back_notes.home.why-cache.p-4: 'Вихід' (exit/output) used for output tokens; ambiguous with 'exit'. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.home.why-agent.p-1: "коштує завантаження файлів і моделі" is awkward: "costs the downloading of files and of the model".
back_notes.home.why-keys.p-1: "ферма агентів" is a literal calque of "agent farm".
back_notes.home.why-keys.ol-1.aria-label: "драбина пріоритетів" (priority ladder) is a literal rendering.
back_notes.home.why-keys.img-1.alt: Contains an untranslated English fragment ('a waiting P9 request always goes before a P8 one') in the middle of Ukrainian text. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.home.why-keys.figcaption-1: 'на зміну яким його створено' ('in whose place it was created') is awkward and unclear. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.clients.grok-cli.capability: 'session_summary залишає запити Grok на назву сеансу на цій моделі' is hard to parse. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.claude-code-router.p-1: "забирає свій промпт ... з вашої машини" and "коштують лише електрики" are slightly awkward/colloquial.
back_notes.claude-code-router.figcaption-1: "запобіжник" (lit. fuse/safety catch) is used for circuit breaker; "розмикається" (opens) is fine but "fuse" reads odd.
back_notes.claude-code-router.img-1.alt: "резервних переходів" (lit. reserve/fallback transitions) is an unusual rendering of "diverted".
back_notes.claude-code-router.p-7: "удвічі менше пам'яті" renders as "twice less memory" (a calque); and "ходи" (moves/turns) for turns is unusual.
back_notes.gpu-monitoring.p-3: "поквилинній панелі" is an unusual coined adjective ("per-minute").
back_notes.cache-aware-routing.p-6: 'вихід' (exit) used for output throughput; ambiguous. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.cache-aware-routing.figcaption-5: 'Це картка, а не результат' ('This is a card, not a result') is unnatural; 'картка' is used both for panel and card. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.cache-aware-routing.p-7: "ферми безінтерфейсних агентів" (lit. "farm of interface-less agents") is a clumsy rendering of "headless".
back_notes.api-keys.p-4: Begins with 'Він' (He/It) with no antecedent; 'Claude Code спрямовує' is an indicative statement where an imperative is evidently meant; 'Прочитайте порівняння (diff) у зворотному напрямку' (read the diff in reverse) is odd. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.features.dd-2: "сховища файлів cookie" (lit. "storage of cookie files") is an awkward calque of "cookie jar".
back_notes.features.dd-9: "Чат для випробувань" (lit. "chat for trials/tests") is an unusual name for a playground.
back_notes.features.img-2.alt: 'Tune kernels на op 2, 21 з 22' is unclear ('op 2, 21 of 22'). | QA r3 verdict: no issue, "Tune kernels at op 2, 21 of 22" mirrors the on-screen UI text exactly as the English does; the reader sees it beside the image.
back_notes.faq.a-2: "Системні параметри" and "Усе одно відкрити" are quoted UI labels; fine, but "Приватність і безпека" differs from the earlier "Конфіденційність і безпека" used for the same macOS section.
back_notes.faq.a-6: "основні версії vLLM ... і llama.cpp" (lit. "main versions") is unclear; presumably "official/upstream", not "main".
back_notes.privacy.p-1: "сам відвідувач своїм візитом" - masculine generic "the visitor himself".
